from appium import webdriver
from appium.options.android import UiAutomator2Options
from appium.webdriver.common.appiumby import AppiumBy
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.common.exceptions import TimeoutException
options = UiAutomator2Options().load_capabilities({
    'platformName': 'Android',
    'appium:automationName': 'UiAutomator2',
    'appium:udid': 'emulator-5554',
    'appium:noReset': True,
    'appium:autoLaunch': False,
    'appium:skipUnlock': True,
    'appium:newCommandTimeout': 300,
})
driver = webdriver.Remote('http://127.0.0.1:56805', options=options)
session_id = driver.session_id
{'sessionId': session_id, 'newCommandTimeout': driver.capabilities.get('newCommandTimeout'), 'platformName': driver.capabilities.get('platformName'), 'automationName': driver.capabilities.get('automationName')}

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
pkg = driver.current_package
act = driver.current_activity
root = ET.fromstring(driver.page_source)
items=[]
for e in root.iter():
    a=e.attrib
    text=a.get('text','').strip(); desc=a.get('content-desc','').strip(); rid=a.get('resource-id','')
    if text or desc or a.get('clickable')=='true':
        items.append({'class':a.get('class','').split('.')[-1], 'text':text, 'desc':desc, 'id':rid.split('/')[-1] if rid else '', 'clickable':a.get('clickable'), 'bounds':a.get('bounds')})
{'package':pkg,'activity':act,'elements':items[:100],'count':len(items)}
